key_insight: Adding one scalar coordinate lifts a convex domain into a cone, unifying several learning-rate-free optimization algorithms through a shared regret analysis.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers principled ways to avoid learning-rate tuning in online and stochastic convex optimization, including on unbounded domains.
method: Lift decisions into a cone and construct subgradients orthogonal to the lifted decisions.
Apply Follow-the-Regularized-Leader or Online Mirror Descent on the cone, leaving comparator scale free in the regret analysis.
Recover CBA and CBA+ on bounded domains and exactly recover KT coin betting on unconstrained Hilbert spaces.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical regret guarantees and exact algorithmic recoveries, but no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Guarantees depend on domain geometry and, for the general closed-convex-domain result, a known gradient bound; the bound-free result targets unconstrained domains.
